annotations.title: Timezone convert: a time in other zones

description: Timezone convert: turn a moment (or now) into up to 10 other time zones in one call, with each zone's local time, UTC offset, weekday and abbreviation, daylight saving time handled. Zones as IANA names or cities (Europe/Stockholm, New York, Tokyo, UTC+2). Use to schedule a meeting across time zones, convert a timestamp for a user, or check business hours somewhere else. Example: to=America/New_York,Asia/Tokyo. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

at.description: Optional moment to convert, as ISO 8601 with an offset or Unix seconds (default: now)

to.description: Time zones or cities to convert into, comma-separated, up to 10 (e.g. America/New_York,Asia/Tokyo)

zone.description: Time zone or city the result is shown in first, e.g. Europe/Stockholm (default UTC)

name: timezone_convert
